connector.name: Fragrance & Perfume MCP (Noteboxd)
connector.registryDescription: Fragrance & perfume MCP: search fragrances, notes, accords, brands, perfumers, reviews & charts.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.noteboxd.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.noteboxd. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
